Hi, 

I had a question regrading the Marginal log-Likelihood score that is shown when getting the summary of a fitted model. How is this quantity computed?

Thank you for your time and consideration, 
Ismael Ahmad

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Marginal log-Likelihood
parts:
the log-likelihood is compute as the log of the normalization constant as
described in the INLA 2009 paper, using the joint approximation as discussed in

https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0167947313001552
